item.summary: The Department of Commerce and EEPC India, the country's apex engineering exports promotion body, held multiple brainstorming sessions as part of the Chintan Shivir for the Engineering Sector to chart a strategy for achieving total engineering goods exports of US$250 billion by 2030, deepening market access through better utilisation of free trade pacts and enhancing the global competitiveness…
item.title: Department of Commerce and EEPC India Hold Chintan Shivir to Chart Strategy for US $250 Billion Engineering Exports by 2030
